test_cases.name: Requesting Quote Revision for Increased Quantity
test_cases.description: The customer, German Cafe, initiates a request to revise an existing quote by increasing the quantity of a previously quoted item. The email provides detailed context about the original quote and the need for an update, in line with the verbose and polite persona and tone. The initial turn establishes the business context and sets up for a follow-up clarification regarding shipment timing or fulfillment preferences.

initial_turn.subject: Request to Revise Existing Quote – Quantity Update Needed
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. Thank you for providing us with the initial quote for our recent inquiry. We have reviewed the details and, after further discussion with our team, we would like to request a revision to the quote you prepared for German Cafe (reference: our quote # if needed for tracking).

Specifically, we would like to increase the quantity of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train that was included in the original quote. Our demand for this item has grown due to an upcoming event, and we want to ensure we have sufficient stock on hand. Could you please update the quote to reflect the new quantity? If you need any additional information from our side to proceed, please let us know.

We appreciate your assistance and look forward to your updated proposal.

Best regards,
German Cafe
